name: Loslor Rudge
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Loslor Rudge keeps Dun Morogh's tinkerers supplied. His goods travel across the snowy ridges to craftsmen such as gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot.

sections.title: A Supplier in the Snow
sections.body:
Loslor Rudge supplies engineering goods from Steelgrill's Depot, just down the road from Kharanos. His stock holds copper modulators, bronze tubing, blasting powder, and spanners. Harsh weather and scattered tinker operations keep these parts in demand, so Loslor works to supply local gearheads.

Deliveries through the wilderness between outposts can be perilous. Near the Grizzled Den, wendigos drove off a courier taking a shortcut. The courier left behind an ammunition shipment meant for Loslor's valued client, gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot.

faq.answer: Loslor Rudge supplies engineering goods from Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. His shop carries tools, parts, and munitions for the region's tinkerers and craftsmen.

faq.q: What trouble does Loslor need help with?
faq.answer: Loslor needs someone to recover an ammunition shipment left in the snow. Wendigos chased away a courier bound for gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot near the Grizzled Den, and the courier abandoned the crate.
Steelgrill's Depot lies just east of Kharanos, along the main road toward Loch Modan. It is a dwarven staging ground and machine workshop.
Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith at a camp in Dun Morogh. He relies on Loslor Rudge for fresh ammunition and mechanical components.

angles.text: Loslor stocks useful engineering supplies, including fluxes, blasting powders, tubes, and tinker's kits. His depot is a handy stop for engineers traveling through Dun Morogh.
Like many artisans in Dun Morogh, Loslor depends on reliable pack routes between scattered dwarf camps. Wendigos can disrupt mountain trade.
